title: <capability tool> output
description: Runs one capability: the MCP tool named by the capability's tool_name, called at the provider adapter's endpoint from peer_get_access with the access token as Authorization: Bearer.

structuredContent.description: The tool's result; validates against the capability's output_schema.

content.description: The tool's content blocks, as MCP returns them.

isError.description: True when the tool failed or the call was refused.

_meta.description: The adapter's answer in _meta.ekl: outcome (succeeded, failed_before_effect, outcome_unknown or cancelled) and admission_id after a run; code, message and retryable when it ran nothing; replay when a kept result is returned for a repeat. The network's signed receipt is read with execution_get.
